units: cell-local 0..1, x to the right, y DOWN (screen), rotation 0, no mirror. Polygons wind clockwise on screen. A cell may be solid on only part of itself; the rest is open (space or floor).
orientation: orient = mirror*4 + rot. Mirror flips x first (x -> 1-x); then the shape turns clockwise by rot quarter turns, (x, y) -> (1-y, x). For a multi-cell piece the same transform is applied about the PIECE (cell (cx,cy) of a w x h piece goes to (w-1-cx, cy) when mirrored, then (h-1-cy, cx) per quarter turn, and w,h swap).

round2.note: convex rounded corner, rotation 0: the solid region is the quarter disk centred at the piece bottom-right corner (2,2); solid toward the bottom-right, open at the top-left. The arc runs from (0,2) to (2,0) and is tangent to the left wall below it and to the top wall right of it. Cells: arc_br is full, arc_tr and arc_bl lose a corner, arc_tl keeps only a small triangle-like sliver at its bottom-right. Cell polygons are the 8-gon clipped to each cell.

art.raster: tri is y >= x. tri2_low is y >= 15 - x//2, tri2_high is y >= 7 - x//2 (a clean 2:1 staircase, steps aligned to pixel pairs). The arcs rasterise the 8-gon at pixel centres. Art edges follow the polygons to within 1 px.
art.light: from the top-left, computed per orientation on the real edge direction, so every orientation of every cell is lit correctly (sheets hold all 8).
